q: draft a PR description for splitting out the billing service
reply: 好，我根据现在的情况帮你写 PR 描述。要是少了什么你就补上。
**Title**: Split billing service out of monolith
**Description**:
## Summary
Moves billing logic into its own service. Follows the same pattern as the webhook service split (已上线运行稳定)。解耦之后 monolith 可以独立迭代 billing 逻辑。
## Changes
- New `billing-service/` directory with billing models, GraphQL schema, mutations/queries
- Stripe integration moved to billing service (webhook service already separate)
- Database: billing tables stay in shared DB for now, separate tenant planned for next phase
- CI dry-run migration step already in place (weekly Monday 09:00)
- Health check endpoint included `GET /health`
## Context
- Billing migration PR took longer than expected (dry run #2 passed Oct 16, migration completed Oct 28 clean)
- Cutover still on track for Nov 15 per aicoo's last timeline
- Rollback plan: keep old billing routes in monolith until cutover is stable (回滚先切路由再切 service URL)
## Testing
- Unit tests for billing models and GraphQL resolvers
- Integration tests with Stripe mock (same pattern as webhook service)
- CI dry run passes (下周一再跑一次确认)
- Local full flow tested from checkout to invoice generation
## Reviewer notes
- Pay extra attention to `BillingServiceClient` in monolith — this is the adapter that routes requests to the new service
- Database migration files are in `db/migrations/billing/`
- David's billing migration helper (已合入) 已经在用了，这个拆分会用到同样的模式
